description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance across five datasets, comparing the performance with and without context for different models. The horizontal axis represents the context categories, labeled as "With Context" and "Without Context", while the vertical axis is labeled "Average Performance" and ranges from 0 to 60 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 10. Each category is represented by three bars, corresponding to "Standard", "CInGS (w/)" and "CInGS" models as indicated by the legend, with the bars colored according to the legend, although the colors are not explicitly described. For the "With Context" category, the blue bars have approximate values of 58, 58, and 60 respectively, while for the "Without Context" category, the purple bars have approximate values of 45, 44, and 43 respectively. The bars within each category are grouped together, with the "Standard", "CInGS (w/)" and "CInGS" models represented by adjacent bars. The bars are not sorted in a specific order within each category, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular bar. Overall, the chart effectively compares the performance of the different models with and without context.
